column1: # cpp-project-template release contract (USEFUL-3, CORE-5, CORE-7, CORE-8).
# Single source of truth for the published inventory. Consumed by
# Fields: os arch toolchain profile format filename validations gitlab support_baseline
#   profile:      gui  = product includes projectwx (MACOSX_BUNDLE on macOS)
#                 cli  = projectwx disabled for this leg
#   filename:     ${V} is replaced with the release version (X.Y.Z)
#   validations:  semicolon-separated checks required of this artifact
#   gitlab:       auto    = produced automatically on every GitLab tag release (floor)
#                 manual  = GitLab job exists but is manual/dormant (best effort)
#                 blocked = GitLab job exists but no runner entitlement yet
#   unsupported combinations are absent: no Linux .zip, no macOS .tar.gz, no .7z/.msix/
